svg.title: INT4 levels for one group
svg.text: INT4 for one real group of 128 weights: 16 levels, placed to make the error smallest
Blue: the weights. Lines down: the 16 levels. Coral: each weight's rounding error (to its nearest level).
Spanning every weight wastes levels on the one far out at the left. Clipping makes that weight saturate
on the last level and gives the other 127 finer steps; the quantizer tries 121 ranges and keeps the best.
